DOWNERS GROVE, Ill. , Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Systech , part of Markem-Imaje and Dover and a leading provider of pharmaceutical serialization and traceability solutions, today announced the launch of the ST33 Carton Serialization Station and ST34 Carton Serialization Station with Tamper Evident , two automated systems designed to help pharmaceutical manufacturers increase packaging line productivity and reduce operational complexity.
 The ST33 and ST34 combine the critical processes required for serialized carton handling into compact, integrated systems that help improve packaging line efficiency. The ST33's small footprint brings automated serialization to space-constrained lines, while the ST34 combines printing, verification and tamper-evident sealing in a single station, reducing the need for separate equipment and operator intervention. Both stations run on Systech UniSeries®, an industry-leading packaging execution and end-to-end serialization software suite, giving manufacturers an integrated hardware and software solution from a single provider.
 "Manufacturers need efficient, high-performing serialization to keep pace with production, and where tamper-evident sealing is required, the code and seal need to be verified together," said Steve Engdahl, Vice President of Product at Systech. "Our approach is built from the line up, shaped by more than 40 years of experience optimizing pharma packaging lines. The ST33 and ST34 reflect that experience, with hardware and software working together to deliver reliable production at scale."
 When printing, verification and sealing run on separate stations, each handoff can introduce stoppages, synchronization problems or inconsistent seal placement. Verification across multiple steps can make it harder to maintain a continuous record for auditors, while print quality must be confirmed during production. Coordinating software from multiple vendors adds further complexity, reinforcing the value of an integrated approach through a single provider.
 The ST33 Carton Serialization Station automates code printing, camera verification and rejection of failed cartons at up to 600 parts per minute, with up to three print positions and smart cameras covering the front, rear and top. The ST34 Carton Serialization Station with Tamper Evident adds tamper-evident sealing at up to 400 parts per minute, verifying both code and seal in a single station. It also includes Smart Line Control and a single operator interface to manage all devices.
 Available now, the stations are designed for pharmaceutical manufacturers, contract manufacturing organizations (CMOs) and contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs) looking to automate and optimize their packaging lines. They form part of Systech's broader integrated hardware portfolio, alongside the ST15S Semi-Automated Serialization and Aggregation Station and ST16P Multi-Aggregation and Automated Label Print & Apply Station .
 About Systech:

CAMBRIDGE, Mass., ROTTERDAM, Netherlands and SHANGHAI , Nov. 18, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Harbour BioMed (the "Company"; HKEX: 02142), a global biopharmaceutical company committed to the discovery and development of novel antibody therapeutics in immunology, oncology and other areas, today announced that the National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) of China has accepted the Investigational New Drug (IND) application for LET003, its first next-generation ACVR2A/2B-targeting monoclonal antibody developed using the Hu-mAtrIx™ AI platform, for the treatment of overweight or obesity.
 Obesity is a chronic, complex disease associated with an increased risk of numerous serious health conditions, including type 2 diabetes, cardiovascular disease and certain cancers. While GLP-1 -based therapies have transformed obesity management by enabling substantial weight loss, the accompanying loss of lean mass remains a major challenge in optimizing body composition and long-term treatment outcomes. Targeting activin receptors ACVR2A and ACVR2B, which play key roles in regulating muscle and fat homeostasis, represents a promising therapeutic approach to enhancing fat reduction while preserving or improving lean mass, particularly in combination with existing weight-loss therapies.
 LET003 is Harbour BioMed's first AI-enabled drug candidate, designed as a dual ACVR2A/ACVR2B blocker to target these receptors. In preclinical studies, LET003 exhibited superior pharmacokinetic characteristics compared to multiple competitor molecules. When combined with semaglutide, LET003 significantly enhanced fat reduction while effectively preserving lean mass. In addition, LET003 achieved lean mass-promoting effects at lower dose level comparable to bimagrumab at higher dose level, highlighting its potential to become a best-in-class therapy for overweight or obesity treatment.
 "NMPA's acceptance of the IND application for LET003 marks a significant milestone for Harbour BioMed. LET003 leads the exciting progress in our obesity portfolio in addition to being our first AI-enabled candidate developed using our proprietary Hu-mAtrIx™ platform," said Dr. Jingsong Wang, Founder, Chairman and CEO of Harbour BioMed. "We look forward to advancing LET003 through clinical development and further realizing the potential of our AI-enabled drug discovery capabilities to address significant unmet medical needs."
 "Obesity treatment is evolving beyond weight reduction alone toward improving body composition and achieving more sustainable health outcomes," said Dr. Bob Zhang, President of the Metabolic Disease Franchise at Harbour BioMed. "By targeting ACVR2A and ACVR2B, LET003 is designed to address an important challenge in overweight or obesity management: preserving or improving lean mass while enhancing fat reduction. We believe LET003 has the potential to offer a differentiated therapeutic approach and look forward to evaluating its potential in clinical development."
 About LET003 
 LET003 is a potential best-in-class next-generation monoclonal antibody targeting activin receptors ACVR2A and ACVR2B. ACVR2A and ACVR2B play critical roles in regulating muscle-fat metabolic homeostasis. Extensive preclinical and clinical studies have demonstrated that combining receptor-blocking antibodies targeting ACVR2A/2B with GLP-1 -based weight loss therapies can further reduce body fat while effectively mitigating lean mass loss. LET003 is the first ACVR2A/2B dual-target blocking antibody developed using the Hu-mAtrIx™ artificial intelligence platform. It has demonstrated superior pharmacokinetic properties compared with several competing molecules and, in preclinical animal models, has shown enhanced fat reduction and lean mass preservation effects when used in combination with GLP-1 therapies.
 About Harbour BioMed 
 Harbour BioMed (HKEX: 02142) is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to the discovery and development of novel antibody therapeutics in immunology, oncology and other areas. The Company is building a robust portfolio and differentiated pipeline through internal R&D capability, strategic global collaborations in co-discovery and co-development, and selective acquisitions.
 Our proprietary antibody technology platform, Harbour Mice ® , generates fully human monoclonal antibodies in both the conventional two heavy and two light chain (H2L2) format and the heavy chain-only (HCAb) format. Building upon HCAb antibodies, the HCAb-based immune cell engagers (HBICE ® ) bispecific antibody technology enables tumor-killing effects that traditional combination therapies cannot achieve. The HCAb-based Antibody Plus technology (HCAb PLUS TM ) provides comprehensive modality solutions for the development of innovative multi-specific medicines in different disease areas. Additionally, building upon the Harbour Mice ® platform, Harbour BioMed launched its first fully human Generative AI HCAb Model powered by its Hu-mAtrIx TM AI platform, accelerating the development of innovative therapies.
 By integrating Harbour Mice ® , HBICE ® , HCAb PLUS TM , a single B-cell cloning platform and AI technologies, Harbour BioMed has built a highly efficient and distinctive antibody discovery engine for developing next-generation therapeutic antibodies. For more information, please visit www.harbourbiomed.com .
